items.description: Tap it to chop the trees on this planet. Higher levels yield more.
Tap it to mine stone and ore on this planet. Free to build. Higher levels yield more.
Tap it to drill ore, crystal and xeno cores. Higher levels yield more.
Tap it to harvest the plant growth on this planet. Higher levels yield more.
Tap it to siphon gas from the atmosphere. Higher levels yield more.
Tap it to excavate buried ice, sand and rare salts. Higher levels yield more.
Sorts wreckage into scrap and the occasional cache. Higher levels yield more.
Converts raw materials into fuel and planks. Higher levels unlock better recipes; level-based batch bonuses are planned.
Draws wire and assembles components. Higher levels unlock better recipes; level-based batch bonuses are planned.
Smelts ore into plates and alloys. Higher levels unlock tougher alloys; level-based batch bonuses are planned.
Mixes composites and charges plasma cells.
Etches quantum chips and grows void alloy, warp coils and antimatter.
Stores resources on this planet. Drag stacks between your backpack and storage. The first upgrades add 9 slots each; the late ones add far more.
Holds fuel cells, plasma and antimatter in dense racks that do not use backpack slots.
Pools every warehouse on this planet, so crafting and building draw from all of them at once.
Planned logistics structure: remotely links warehouses across a system and later the galaxy. Replaces the old Satellite.
Rapid fire kinetic turret. Fires during waves.
Slow, heavy beam with long range. Fires during waves.
Projects a field that raises reactor health.
Launches a splash missile that clears clustered raiders. Fires during waves.
Arcs lightning between nearby aliens. Fires during waves.
Slowly repairs the reactor during a wave.
Tap it to burn fuel and call a wave. More fuel means a longer fight and bigger rewards.
Unlocks research. Higher levels open deeper research nodes and tool tiers.
Extends the survey radius: see more worlds around you before you jump.
Adds builder crews at levels 3 and 7. Obstacle clearing is planned for a later update.
A spaceport hangar: cuts the fuel cost of every trip.
Slowly gathers raw bulk materials while you are away. Active harvesting stays far better.
Megaproject. Reshapes the planet in five stages; each stage permanently raises harvest yield everywhere.
Megaproject. A ring gate in orbit: each stage cuts fuel costs and extends jump range.
Megaproject. A swarm of collectors around the star feeds your ships fuel while you sleep.
